guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first; this one pops automatically once they are all unlocked.
No online play or DLC is needed. One playthrough is enough, at roughly 200 hours.
Keep cheats off for the whole run, as cheats disable trophies and saving.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

guide: Play through every main mission in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the first main mission of Chapter 2 begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

guide: Play through every main mission in Chapter 2.
The trophy pops when the first main mission of Chapter 3 begins.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

guide: Play through every main mission in Chapter 3.
The trophy pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

guide: Play through every main mission in Chapter 4.
The trophy pops after the final main mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

guide: Finish the story by completing the final main mission in Chapter 5.
The trophy pops automatically at the end of the mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

guide: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Trust

guide: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

guide: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Family Matters

guide: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

guide: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

guide: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

guide: After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist.

Work through the checklist: any 100 optional missions, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, all robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks.
Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida, mixing Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights and Base Jumps.
Under the Bridges stunts are the quickest to clear; track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts.
The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt.
Check Progress, then Activities, to see which types you have done.
Most types are introduced by the story; filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the rest.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Visit all 12 shooting ranges and earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Use a steady aim and a weapon you are comfortable with; gold thresholds are forgiving.
All ranges stay open after the story, so clean this up in free-roam if needed.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total).
Learn each course's racing line first, then push for the win; you can retry any race.
All drone races are required for the 100% checklist too, so this comes naturally.
trophies.name: Top Fun

guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida.
Use a fast, well-handling car and learn the corners; each race only needs one win.
Races stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Meet Cal during the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui.
After that, Cal sends a text marking a fishing location west of Key Lento; go there and beat him in the fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

guide: Play one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world.
Finish all levels of any one game to complete it; you do not need to beat every challenge.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia.
While playing as Lucia in Chapter 3, take Andy's call, then follow her texts to her home in Belville.
Complete all 5 Andy quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass, to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams.
After his call, find him at the green KR icon in Key Lento and dive for the treasures he marks on the map.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks he asks for; if he goes quiet, keep playing the story and he returns in Chapter 2-3.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all 5 Billy quests, ending with Hometown Heroes, to unlock the trophy.
All of his quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks questlines found in the open world.
Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries).
Note that Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses, Randy, Yasmani and Eddie questlines do not count toward this trophy; watch the trophy tracker instead of counting every optional contact.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Randy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him.
Steal the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List and deliver them to his garage in west Vice City; scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if they are wanted.
Deliver the final car to unlock the trophy; all of it can be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason.
Go to the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter.
After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives the quest Spin On This; shut down the labs to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
guide: WARNING: this is the only missable trophy. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept.
Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia where a spot allows it; each spot done with both characters counts double.
Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The final meditation needs both characters playable together, unlocked after Chapter 2 Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break; while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Do Bret's first quest; he then marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map.
Hunt the unique animal he requests and bring it back to Bret as Jason. His questline is exclusive to Jason and stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

guide: Collect cards found around Leonida and complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets.
Cards are scattered across the map; check your collection progress to see which sets are closest to done.
You do not need all 18 sets for this trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

guide: Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a scannable object and hold R1 to scan it.
Scan any 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are available, plus No Flusher tags.
Scan everything you pass while exploring and this fills up naturally.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game.
Track them under Progress, then Challenges; pick the easiest ones first.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this unlocks automatically on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Unlock free-roam with your partner after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, then call your partner with Right plus Triangle.
Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape until you leave the red heat zone entirely.
A fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well; helicopters struggle to follow you there. This also pops naturally during bank vault robberies.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: After Chapter 2 Coffee Break, call your partner and keep a wanted level active the whole time.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level; equip an armored vest and sticky bombs and carry Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

guide: Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan vehicles by looking at them and holding R1; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic until 100 unique vehicles are discovered.
Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so this comes automatically.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar.
Buff focus first with food, drinks, or a shower, and consume Adrenaline to extend the focus time.

Line up 5 clustered enemies, such as criminals at a Gang Operation, and drop them with an assault rifle like the Duke 556 before the bar runs out. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Go to Vice City International Airport and steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal boarding bridge; the easiest is at terminals E3/E4.
Board through the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy unlock is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

guide: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
Enter through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, then climb into a tank in the south of the base.
Shoot enemies with the tank until the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door, which triggers the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave quietly. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

guide: Unlock bank vault robberies through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, waiting at the cafe; tail the security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open.
Bring your partner, as you cannot carry all the cash bags alone; hand off a bag with Right.
Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time; the 100% checklist needs all 8. Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security van tips to find the rest.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Robbing a bank vault in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank.
Alternatively, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius afterwards; the trophy only unlocks once you have escaped.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

guide: Fully unfog the whole map by visiting every area of Leonida.
The fastest way is to fly a plane over all the black fogged areas until the entire map is visible.
Every region must be revealed; check the map for any remaining fog.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs; there are 39 operations in total.
Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress.
Track per-gang progress under Progress, then Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this comes automatically.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
guide: First obtain the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and steal the blue Banshee inside using the Key Cloner.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window; the trophy pops shortly after you drive away down the street. Only this specific blue Banshee counts.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
guide: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a Gang Operation marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.

Steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe contents in the north-east hallway office (code 0300, or blow it with sticky bombs).
Escape the police afterwards; the trophy unlocks after the escape, not when you grab the third item. Valuables you missed can be collected on a later robbery once the icon respawns.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time; check Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia.
This is only possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters.
Buy a fitness club membership and always work out together with your partner (call them with Right plus Triangle); while one trains, the other trains too, doubling progress.
trophies.name: Personal Best

guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; track the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts.
Robberies, clean escapes, stealth objectives and enemy encounters all count, so this fills up passively while working on other trophies.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer.
Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, alone as Lucia without Jason.
Aim at the teller, take out the security, break through the door, empty the 3 cash drawers, then escape on foot (not in a vehicle) until you are clear of the police search area.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

guide: Go alone at night, after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back, as the spawn is slightly random.
Follow the path into the woods from the car to find the UFO, approach it, talk to the woman it drops, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
guide: Ride any bike into a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick pedestrians with Square while riding; you need 10 kicks within 60 seconds.
Keep moving through the crowd and keep kicking until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Deliver a cumulative total of $250,000 in marked bills; it does not need to be in one trip. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 per robbery.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

guide: Spend a cumulative total of $100,000 across all shop types.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to reach the total, as they are the most expensive.
Spending counts across all shops combined; it does not need to be in one place.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone; the 4 story garages do not count.
Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver and cost $160,000 in total.
Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest way to earn the money.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses.
Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes), as each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles.

Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register; cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down. Later Chapter 3 progress also allows registering Standard Tracker cars at Pay 'n' Sprays.
trophies.name: On the Spot
